[LSTR.11.1] A `String` slot may declare `capacity N` ([LGRA.5.1]), where
`N` is a positive integer. Every value the slot holds then has at most `N`
codepoints, counted as `len` counts them ([LSTR.2.1]). A slot that declares no
`capacity` is unbounded.

`capacity` is admitted on `String` slots only. The compiler must refuse it on a
slot of any other type (`DS_VALIDATE_CAPACITY_BAD_TYPE`), and must refuse an
`N` below 1 (`DS_VALIDATE_CAPACITY_NOT_POSITIVE`).
